item_id.description: Unique SKU or stock item identifier.

agent_name.description: Restricted strictly to the Inventory & Payroll agent module.

current_stock_level.description: Current physical quantity available in stock.

reorder_threshold.description: Minimum stock level that triggers an automated reorder alert.

restock_required.description: Flag indicating whether stock has breached the minimum threshold.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 compliant UTC timestamp of the inventory check.
